messages.text:
The best score acts strangely. A worse game can replace it, and a size I've never finished shows 0. Could you fix that and keep the rest working? Please follow the project rules.

Read docs/README.md and the other documents in docs/ for this project's requirements.

Fixed both best-score issues:

- [storage.ts](/work/src/game/session/storage.ts:60) now keeps the saved best when a completed game has an equal or higher move count.
- [GameStatus.tsx](/work/src/game/status/GameStatus.tsx:30) shows `Best: none` when that size has no record.

`git diff --check` passed. I left tests and builds unrun, as the project instructions say not to run them unless requested.
